alternate_mechanisms.description: The plant and pasture branches supply fruit, fodder, and food; the woman/person branches supply palatable food and household feeding; masad supplies a food vessel; and the esophagus branches locate nourishment at the neck. The surface reverses the entire provisioning chain: the wife carries fuel rather than food, vegetation feeds fire rather than bodies, and the neck's swallowing region receives a rope rather than nourishment.
alternate_mechanisms.guardrail: This is a cross-root underlay, not a claim that any surface word should be translated as food, lamb, or vessel.

alternate_mechanisms.description: Successive lightning, water-bearing cloud, visible fire from afar, and the human carrier of dry wood form a remote atmospheric contrast. The same bearing image can carry rain or carry fuel; in this passage the life-preserving water side is absent while flame and dry material dominate.

alternate_mechanisms.title: Yoke, mark, and punitive signature
